requirements.title: FHIR R4 canonical pivot
requirements.statement: SDK SHALL use FHIR R4 as the canonical pivot.

requirements.title: CanonicalEnvelope shape
requirements.statement: SDK SHALL define a CanonicalEnvelope with payload + terminology + metadata.

requirements.title: Any-to-any translation
requirements.statement: SDK SHALL support any-to-any translation across declared adapters.

requirements.title: FHIR R4 base profile
requirements.statement: Pivot SHALL be FHIR R4 conformant.

requirements.title: FHIR R5 transition plan
requirements.statement: Pivot SHALL document FHIR R5 transition plan.

requirements.title: SNOMED CT code binding
requirements.statement: Terminology SHALL include SNOMED CT bindings.

requirements.title: UCUM unit binding
requirements.statement: Quantitative observations SHALL bind UCUM units.

requirements.title: RxNorm code binding
requirements.statement: Medication codes SHALL bind RxNorm where applicable.

requirements.title: dm+d code binding
requirements.statement: UK medication codes SHALL bind dm+d.

requirements.title: Profile resolution registry
requirements.statement: Pivot SHALL maintain a profile resolution registry.

requirements.title: HL7 v2 MLLP inbound
requirements.statement: SDK SHALL accept HL7 v2 over MLLP.

requirements.title: DICOM C-FIND/C-STORE inbound
requirements.statement: SDK SHALL accept DICOM C-FIND / C-STORE.

requirements.title: CDA R2 inbound
requirements.statement: SDK SHALL accept CDA R2 documents.

requirements.title: Nexus A2A inbound
requirements.statement: SDK SHALL accept Nexus A2A messages.

requirements.title: MCP tool-call inbound
requirements.statement: SDK SHALL accept MCP tool calls.

requirements.title: HL7 v2 MLLP outbound
requirements.statement: SDK SHALL emit HL7 v2 over MLLP.

requirements.title: CDA R2 outbound
requirements.statement: SDK SHALL emit CDA R2 documents.

requirements.title: Nexus A2A outbound
requirements.statement: SDK SHALL emit Nexus A2A messages.

requirements.title: MCP tool-call outbound
requirements.statement: SDK SHALL emit MCP tool calls.

requirements.title: SSE outbound
requirements.statement: SDK SHALL emit SSE push messages.

requirements.title: Routing rule engine
requirements.statement: SDK SHALL include a routing rule engine.

requirements.title: Error envelope normalisation
requirements.statement: Errors SHALL be normalised across adapters.

requirements.title: Replay queue for retries
requirements.statement: Retries SHALL use a replay queue.

requirements.title: Correlation ID propagation
requirements.statement: Correlation ID SHALL propagate across adapters.

requirements.title: GDPR lawful basis
requirements.statement: EU deployments SHALL declare GDPR lawful basis.

requirements.title: ISO 13485 QMS
requirements.statement: Where applicable, ISO 13485 QMS SHALL be evidenced.

requirements.title: Audit log retention
requirements.statement: Audit log retention SHALL be declared.

requirements.title: Right to be forgotten
requirements.statement: Erasure SHALL propagate through translated history.

requirements.title: Adapter conformance suite
requirements.statement: Adapters SHALL ship a conformance suite.

requirements.title: Healthcare.gov interop tests
requirements.statement: Where applicable, HC.gov interop tests SHALL be passed.

requirements.title: HL7 v2 conformance profile
requirements.statement: HL7 v2 adapter SHALL declare conformance profile.

requirements.title: DICOM conformance statement
requirements.statement: DICOM adapter SHALL ship conformance statement.

requirements.title: X12 implementation guide adherence
requirements.statement: X12 adapter SHALL adhere to documented IGs.

requirements.title: Bulk Data conformance
requirements.statement: FHIR Bulk Data SHALL be supported.

requirements.title: MCP server manifest
requirements.statement: MCP adapter SHALL publish server manifest.

requirements.title: A2A agent card
requirements.statement: Nexus A2A adapter SHALL publish agent card.

requirements.title: OTel traces
requirements.statement: All adapters SHALL emit OTel traces.

requirements.title: OTel metrics
requirements.statement: All adapters SHALL emit OTel metrics.

requirements.title: OTel logs
requirements.statement: All adapters SHALL emit OTel logs.

requirements.title: Per-adapter error rate metric
requirements.statement: Per-adapter error rate SHALL be emitted.

requirements.title: Translation latency histogram
requirements.statement: Translation latency SHALL be emitted as histogram.

requirements.title: Replay queue depth metric
requirements.statement: Replay queue depth SHALL be emitted.

requirements.title: Adapter health endpoint
requirements.statement: Each adapter SHALL expose a health endpoint.

requirements.title: Audit log per translation
requirements.statement: Each translation SHALL emit audit log.

requirements.title: OIDC JWT auth
requirements.statement: Endpoints SHALL be authenticated via OIDC JWT.

requirements.title: mTLS transport
requirements.statement: Endpoints SHALL support mTLS transport option.

requirements.title: Per-principal rate limit
requirements.statement: Endpoints SHALL apply per-principal rate limit.

requirements.title: Secret rotation policy
requirements.statement: Secrets SHALL be rotated per policy.

requirements.title: VDP
requirements.statement: Operators SHALL maintain a vulnerability disclosure programme.

requirements.title: REA template registry coverage
requirements.statement: SDK SHALL trace consumed REA template families.

requirements.title: REA gap-filler ingestion
requirements.statement: SDK SHALL ingest REA gap-filler output.

requirements.title: REA coverage heatmap export
requirements.statement: SDK SHALL emit REA coverage heatmap.

requirements.title: REA derive_all batch run
requirements.statement: SDK SHALL support REA batch runs.

requirements.title: REA anomaly diagnostics
requirements.statement: SDK SHALL expose REA anomaly diagnostics.

requirements.title: Helm chart parity
requirements.statement: SDK deployments SHALL be evidenced by an in-tree Helm chart.

requirements.title: Backups encrypted at rest
requirements.statement: Backups SHALL be encrypted at rest.

requirements.title: Incident response playbook
requirements.statement: Operators SHALL link to incident response playbook.

requirements.title: Status page
requirements.statement: Operators SHALL run a status page.

requirements.title: SLSA attestation
requirements.statement: Releases SHALL include SLSA supply-chain attestation.

requirements.title: Canonical FHIR R4 pivot type
requirements.statement: SDK SHALL provide a canonical FHIR R4 pivot type that source-system payloads can be mapped into.

requirements.title: Bridge envelope emission
requirements.statement: SDK SHALL emit a bridge envelope with payload, terminology, and metadata intact after pivot.

requirements.title: Envelope contract validation
requirements.statement: SDK SHALL validate required payload, terminology, and metadata fields on every envelope.

requirements.title: Any-to-any adapter translation
requirements.statement: SDK SHALL enable any-to-any adapter translation via the canonical pivot without pairwise mapping.

requirements.title: FHIR R4 profile conformance
requirements.statement: SDK SHALL check FHIR R4 profile conformance and return a conformant envelope OR a validation failure.

requirements.title: R5 transition plan
requirements.statement: SDK SHALL document a FHIR R5 transition plan keeping R4 behaviour stable.

requirements.title: Compatibility traceability
requirements.statement: SDK SHALL trace compatibility changes through requirements and canonical scenarios.

requirements.title: Adapter registry
requirements.statement: SDK SHALL register source and target adapters that consume the canonical pivot.

requirements.title: Import stability
requirements.statement: SDK MUST be import-stable across all sibling repos (no breaking pivot changes within R4 lifecycle).

requirements.title: BulletTrain Integration Constitution
requirements.statement: SDK MUST refuse to call sibling systems directly; cross-system traffic via bullettrain.connectors.* or api_gateway hub.

requirements.title: Pip-installable, import-clean
requirements.statement: SDK MUST be pip-installable and import-clean (no implicit network IO at import time).

requirements.title: Deterministic serialisation
requirements.statement: Envelope serialisation MUST be deterministic (stable field ordering for audit replay).
